project.title: Wastewater Treatment Plant Bacterial 16srRNAsequencing
project.description: 101 microbial samples of cold rolling wastewater from nine regions across China using high-throughput sequencing, revealing rich microbial diversity and distinct regional aggregation patterns.
project.center_name: University of science and technology of China
